install:
set -euo pipefail
touch "$HOME/.bashrc"
if ! grep -qxF '# >>> troupe-agent-env >>>' "$HOME/.bashrc"; then
  tmp_rc="$(mktemp)"
  {
    printf '%s\n' \
      '# >>> troupe-agent-env >>>' \
      'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' \
      'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' \
      'export CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only' \
      '# <<< troupe-agent-env <<<'
    cat "$HOME/.bashrc"
  } > "$tmp_rc"
  cat "$tmp_rc" > "$HOME/.bashrc"
  rm -f "$tmp_rc"
fi
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
export CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pkgs=(ca-certificates curl jq libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev libdbus-1-dev patchelf libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev mesa-vulkan-drivers libxkbcommon-x11-0 xvfb)
  missing=0
  for pkg in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
    dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'install ok installed' || { missing=1; break; }
  done
  if [ "$missing" -eq 1 ]; then
    sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y
    sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${pkgs[@]}"
  fi
fi
bun_ver="1.3.14"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.bun/bin"
if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ] && { [ ! -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ] || [ "$("$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$bun_ver" ]; }; then
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) bun_plat="linux-x64"; bun_sha256="e3ee6722a9e2dbb691dd8877658e24012aab0b1a712028c1587d8e32ac726109" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) bun_plat="linux-aarch64"; bun_sha256="97631ecfb616c248a4662599c555a59e2a18140a2ec1c0038a89bff08b815169" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported arch: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT
  curl -fsSL "https://registry.npmjs.org/@oven/bun-${bun_plat}/-/bun-${bun_plat}-${bun_ver}.tgz" -o "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$bun_sha256" "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
  tar -xzf "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz" -C "$tmp_dir" package/bin/bun
  install -m 0755 "$tmp_dir/package/bin/bun" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"
  ln -sfn bun "$HOME/.bun/bin/bunx"
  rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
  trap - EXIT
fi
rustup target list --installed | grep -qx 'wasm32-unknown-unknown' || rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
rustup toolchain list | grep -q '^1\.99\.1-' || rustup toolchain install 1.99.1 --profile minimal --component clippy,rustfmt --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
bun install --frozen-lockfile
mkdir -p node_modules/.cache
bun -e "import { canaryBun } from './scripts/test.ts'; await canaryBun()"
bun scripts/canvas/check-figcraft-pin.mjs
if [ ! -s canvas/bundle/index.html ] || ! cmp -s canvas/figcraft.pin node_modules/.cache/troupe-figcraft.pin; then
  bun scripts/canvas/fetch-figcraft-bundle.mjs
  cp canvas/figcraft.pin node_modules/.cache/troupe-figcraft.pin
fi
web_stamp="$(git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z -- src public index.html vite.config.web.ts tsconfig.web.json tailwind.config.ts postcss.config.js package.json bun.lock | LC_ALL=C sort -z | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum -- "$f"; else printf 'missing %s\n' "$f"; fi; done | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
if [ ! -s dist-web/index.html ] || [ "$(cat node_modules/.cache/troupe-dist-web.sha256 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$web_stamp" ]; then
  bun run build:web
  printf '%s\n' "$web_stamp" > node_modules/.cache/troupe-dist-web.sha256
fi
cargo fetch --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
cargo fetch --manifest-path apps/rune/Cargo.toml
